title: Design: long and special customer names on the Customers tab and dialog
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan), on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier), on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>), on tier A for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Click the Remove Customers tab.
  6. Tick customer B.
  7. Click Remove 1 Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer A's, customer B's and customer C's names stay inside the Customer column of their own rows and never cover the channel column.
  • Every column stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Customer C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • Each name stays inside its own row; no name covers the Work Order Tier column.
  • The dialog does not grow wider than the window.

Step 6:

  • Customer B's row shows its Work Orders and Part Sales boxes beside the name, fully visible, inside the dialog.
  • The footer and buttons stay visible.

Step 7:

  • The question names the removal inside its own box; the text wraps inside the dialog and Keep Customers and Remove stay visible.
